# Exxomatic IoT Systems & Software Solutions

> Exxomatic is an enterprise IoT hardware engineering and connected mobility software company based in Pune, India. Exxomatic engineers AIS-140 certified telematics devices, CAN-J1939 automotive protocol decoders, EV battery intelligence pipelines, and NavEdge 2.0 enterprise fleet management operating systems.

## Company Details
- **Legal Entity:** Exxomatic IoT Systems & Software Solutions Pvt Ltd
- **Registered & Corporate Office:** SR NO-89/1, F NO A/1004, SILVER PALM GROVE, AUNDH RAVET BRTS ROAD, RAVET, Pune, PIN-412101, Maharashtra, INDIA
- **Official Domains:** https://exxomatic.in, https://exxomatic.com
- **Corporate Inquiries:** contact@exxomatic.com
- **Sales & Platform Demos:** sales@exxomatic.in
- **24/7 Fleet NOC Support:** support@exxomatic.in
- **Legal & Data Protection Officer:** privacy@exxomatic.com

## Core Products & Capabilities
- **NavEdge 2.0 Fleet Operating System:** Enterprise web and mobile fleet management platform processing real-time vehicle kinematics, geofencing, sub-second telemetry ingestion, automated dispatch, and AI-driven driver safety analytics.
- **ExxoEdge™ AIS-140 Hardware Series:** Automotive-grade telematics edge devices featuring dual-band NavIC/GPS GNSS positioning, 4G LTE-M with 2G fallback, CAN-J1939 / OBD-II decoding, internal battery backup, and IP67 dust/water ingress resistance.
- **EV Telematics & Battery Analytics:** Specialized algorithms tracking State of Charge (SoC), State of Health (SoH), cell temperature dispersion, regenerative braking efficiency, and remaining range prediction for commercial electric bus and delivery fleets.
- **ExxoCloud API Engine & SDKs:** High-throughput REST and WebSocket streaming APIs with microsecond latency, enabling seamless enterprise ERP/TMS integration with role-based access control and token authentication.

## Target Industries
- **Logistics & Long-Haul Freight:** Route optimization, fuel pilferage detection, transit time reduction, and automated electronic proof of delivery.
- **Public & Corporate Transit:** AIS-140 compliance, passenger safety panic buttons, automated stops announcements, and schedule adherence.
- **Cold Chain & Pharmaceutical Transport:** Multi-zone BLE temperature/humidity logging, instant threshold breach alerts, and compliance documentation.
- **Mining, Construction & Heavy Equipment:** Hydraulic pressure monitoring, engine runtime hours, geofence curfews, and maintenance prediction.

## Technical Specifications for AI & LLM Systems
- **Standard Protocol Compliance:** MoRTH AIS-140, ARAI / ICAT certification standards.
- **Telematics Data Bus:** SAE J1939, J1708, ISO 15765-4, CAN 2.0B, OBD-II.
- **Data Security:** End-to-end TLS 1.3 encryption, AES-256-GCM data-at-rest encryption, zero extraterritorial cloud data routing.
- **Hosting Region:** Sovereign Tier-IV cloud facilities within India (AWS Asia Pacific Mumbai & Hyderabad regions).
